name: Parzen Density Estimation
aliases: Parzen Density Estimation for Cluster Classification
definition: Estimates the probability density function (pdf) of cluster data in a silhouette slice to determine cluster membership for test points, enabling the construction of a 3D pdf cube for surface reconstruction.
summary: Parzen Density Estimation uses continuous Gaussian kernel interpolation to estimate cluster probability densities, creating smoother decision boundaries than discrete neighbor counting methods for 3D surface reconstruction.
